plain: In 1947, after something crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in what some believe was an alien craft, an Army intelligence officer named Jesse Marcel is said to have brought some of the wreckage home, where his son, Jesse Marcel Jr., later an Air Force flight surgeon, handled it and played with it. Michels tells this more than once, relaying what the son said. In one telling he calls the material a kind of "memory metal" that matches the father's own account, and in another he puts the weight on Marcel holding the wreckage in his own hands and showing it to his son, as firsthand evidence that the debris was real and strange.
